title: POV: You Only Pay the Minimum on a $3,000 Card… It Takes 15 YEARS 😱

lines: Mia owes three thousand dollars on her credit card. So she pays the minimum. Every month.
scenes.img: a young woman with a ponytail on a couch paying a credit card bill on her phone, relieved but tired face, vertical composition

lines: The interest rate? Twenty two percent. Pretty normal for a card.
scenes.img: a young woman with a ponytail squinting suspiciously at a plain credit card in her hand, a glowing red warning triangle symbol floating beside her, cozy room, no text, vertical composition

lines: Her first minimum payment is about eighty five dollars. Feels fine, right?
scenes.img: a young woman with a ponytail shrugging with a small smile, a bill showing a small payment amount, vertical composition

lines: But most of it is just interest. And as the balance drops, so does the minimum.
scenes.img: a young woman with a ponytail watching coins drip slowly out of her wallet into a huge pile labeled bank, worried face, vertical composition

lines: Keep paying only the minimum, and it takes about fifteen years to be debt free.
scenes.img: an older a young woman with a ponytail with a few gray hairs still paying a credit card bill, calendar pages flying past, vertical composition

lines: She'd pay around four thousand four hundred dollars in interest. More than she borrowed.
scenes.img: a young woman with a ponytail shocked looking at a long receipt unrolling to the floor, vertical composition

lines: Now the fix. Pay a fixed one fifty a month instead. Done in about two years. Around seven hundred seventy dollars in interest.
scenes.img: {HERO} on a couch setting up a fixed monthly payment on his phone, calm confident smile, vertical composition

lines: Same card. Same debt. Thirteen years faster. Follow for one simple money move every day!
scenes.img: {HERO} walking happily down a sunny street cutting a credit card in half, vertical composition
